transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi, it's really nice to meet you too. Thank you for taking the time to see me. 

Um... I guess what made me come in is... well, I hope it's okay to bring this up, but I just keep feeling like I've kind of ruined things for everybody lately. It sounds silly saying it out loud, I know. But I'm doing my pipefitting apprenticeship right now, and I just feel like a total fake. Like I'm letting my family down, and even the younger apprentices... just over little mistakes, you know? Stuff I know other people would probably just fix and move on from, but I can't seem to let it go. 

Does that make sense as a reason to be here? I'm sorry, I know it's probably not a huge deal compared to what you usually see, I just wanted to make sure I'm doing the right thing by coming in.
Do you find yourself worrying about a lot of different things, not just mistakes at your apprenticeship?

Um... no, I don't think so? I mean, I hope it's okay to say that. I don't really worry about a ton of other stuff... just the normal things, I guess? 

It's really mostly just the apprenticeship and, you know, feeling like I'm messing up there. I definitely don't want to sound like I'm complaining about every little thing in my life, because I know I have it pretty good, you know? I don't just sit around stressing about everything. So, yeah, it's pretty much just the work stuff and my family. 

Is that... is that helpful? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right information.
Did these feelings start after something specific happened in your apprenticeship?

Um... no, not really. I mean, nothing big happened. I hope it doesn't sound like I'm making a big deal out of nothing. It's just... I guess it just sort of crept up on me? Like, I'll just be doing a normal weld or measuring something, and I'll second-guess myself, and then I just feel awful about it. 

There wasn't, like, a huge accident or anything where I ruined a project. I'd never want you to think I'm careless or anything like that. I really try my best. It just feels like lately my best isn't good enough, you know? 

I hope that answers your question. I'm sorry if that wasn't very specific. Am I explaining it okay?
Have you been feeling down or depressed most days?

Um... well, I wouldn't really say I've been feeling depressed. I mean, depressed is a pretty strong word, right? I hope it's okay to say that. 

I just feel... maybe a little down sometimes? Like, just kind of bummed out about the apprenticeship stuff I mentioned. But definitely not, like, crying all day or unable to get out of bed or anything like that. I really try to keep a positive attitude, you know? I don't want to be a burden on anyone by being mopey all the time. 

So, yeah, just a little down sometimes, but mostly I'm okay. I hope that's the kind of answer you were looking for? I just want to make sure I'm not making things sound worse than they actually are.
Do you often avoid social or work situations because you’re afraid people will criticize or reject you?

Um... no, not really. I mean, I definitely still go to work and everything. I wouldn't want anyone to think I'm slacking off or avoiding my responsibilities, you know? I take my apprenticeship really seriously. 

I guess maybe sometimes I get a little nervous if I have to show my boss a pipe I just fitted, just because I want to do a good job. But I don't avoid it. I wouldn't just hide from people or anything like that. I really try to get along with everyone on the crew. 

Is that what you meant? I hope I'm answering these questions right. I just want to make sure I'm giving you a clear picture.
Have you lost interest in things you usually enjoy?

Um... well, maybe a little bit? I hope that doesn't make me sound lazy or ungrateful for the free time I have. 

It's just that... well, lately I can just walk right past my sketchbook, and I've been skipping out on my recreational volleyball league. I've even been ignoring the group texts for this volunteer thing I do. It's weird because those used to be the things that really made me feel like myself, you know? 

But I'm not, like, completely shutting down or anything! I still do my chores and go to work. I just... haven't felt like doing my fun stuff as much, I guess. I hope that's not too unusual? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right kind of information.
Have you been feeling guilty or worthless a lot lately?

Um... well... I guess maybe a little bit? I hope it's okay to admit that. I don't want you to think I'm just feeling sorry for myself or anything. 

It's actually kind of why I decided to come in. I just... I keep having these thoughts that I'm ruining things for everybody. Like, I feel like I'm a total fake in my apprenticeship, and that I'm letting my family down, and even the younger apprentices. 

And the thing is, I know it's over stuff that other people would probably just fix and move on from, you know? Like, a small mistake on a pipe fitting or something. But I just can't seem to shake this feeling that I'm letting everyone down. 

I really try not to let it show, though! I don't want to make a big deal out of nothing or make anyone else feel bad. Is it normal to feel like that sometimes? I just want to make sure I'm not overreacting.
Have you noticed your sleep has changed lately?

Um... yeah, I guess my sleep has been a little different lately. I hope I don't sound like I'm complaining, because I know everyone gets tired sometimes! 

But, well... for a while there, I was actually doing really great on just, like, three or four hours of sleep. I'd wake up feeling totally wired and ready for work and my classes, which was honestly kind of helpful for getting things done. But... lately it's changed. 

Now it's like I either just can't seem to fall asleep at all, or I wake up way before my alarm goes off, and I just feel... I don't know, like I haven't rested at all. I really try to push through it at work, though! I don't want my boss to think I'm slacking just because I'm a little tired. 

Is that the kind of thing you're looking for? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right details.
When you were doing well on only three or four hours of sleep, did you also feel unusually energetic or 'up' compared with your normal self?

Um... well, yeah, I guess I did feel pretty energetic back then. I hope that doesn't make me sound like I'm bragging or anything! It's just that... well, there were a few weeks where I felt almost, like, too good? 

I felt like Miami was just mine for the taking, you know? Like I could handle anything. But... I guess I was also getting a little frustrated with people sometimes. Like, if a coworker was slowing me down on a job, I might have snapped at them a little harder than I normally would. 

I really try to be a good team player, though! I don't want you to think I'm hard to work with. It's just... I had all this energy and I just wanted to get things done. Is it okay that I felt like that? I just want to make sure I'm not making myself sound like a bad person.
During that time when you needed only three or four hours of sleep, were you taking on a lot more projects or staying much busier than usual?

Um... yeah, I guess I was staying pretty busy. I hope it doesn't sound like I'm trying to make myself sound super important or anything! I just... I really like being helpful, you know?

So during that time, I kind of... well, I signed myself up to help some of my classmates with their work, and I volunteered to do extra design sketches for the older guys at the shop. I even started messaging some old contacts to see if they needed help with any side projects. 

I just felt like I could handle it all! But... I guess looking back, I might have taken on a little more than I could actually finish. Like, part of me probably knew there weren't enough hours in the day for all of it, but I just really wanted to pitch in and do a good job. 

I didn't mean to overcommit, I promise! I just wanted to be useful. Is it normal to get a little carried away like that when you have a lot of energy? I just want to make sure I'm doing the right thing.
During that time, were you talking much more than usual?

Um... yeah, I guess I was talking a bit more than I usually do. I really hope I didn't annoy anyone too much! I just... I had all these thoughts and I wanted to share them, you know?

Like, when I was in class or at the shop, I'd start explaining an idea for a pipe layout or something, and I just... I guess I would just keep going. I'd get so excited that I was probably talking over people a little bit, and I don't think I was even stopping to take a breath. 

I mean, I could kind of tell that the older guys at the shop were trying to get back to work, but I just had so much to say and I really wanted them to understand my ideas. I feel really bad if I was holding them up! I try so hard to be respectful of everyone's time. 

Does that make sense? I just want to make sure I'm not making it sound like I'm a loudmouth or anything, I just get a little passionate about my work sometimes. Is it okay that I was talking that much?
